clusters.name: arm-fail-loud-guard
clusters.executionModeRationale: Must run serially in a single job: US-002's tests exercise the US-001 implementation in lib/listener-loop.js, and US-003's version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS bump is a release-gating step that must follow green code + tests. Splitting into parallel jobs would race on lib/listener-loop.js and the six version stamps for no throughput gain on a ~3-file change.
